process_area.title: ROU Asset & Lease Liability Measurement, Modification & Reporting

workflows.name: Subsequent Measurement — Depreciation, Interest & Payment Unwind

Automation Opportunity: - Automated monthly engine; auto-journal posting to GL; AP/cash reconciliation; EBITDA-impact dashboard
Controls: - CTL-675 (ensure controlled execution — ROU Asset & Lease Liability Measurement, Modification & Reporting (PA-148.2).)
- CTL-675: system-calculated depreciation/interest; reconciled to GL/AP/cash (W4425); variances investigated; reviewed monthly
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (GL/R2R), VS-15 (AP), VS-18 (treasury), VS-21 (audit), W4412 (rate), W4414 (recognition), W4425 (close), W4428 (controls)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Engine-error risk**: wrong depreciation/interest → mis-stated P&L/balance sheet; mitigated by system engine & reconciliation
- **P&L-distortion risk**: EBITDA jump from rent→depreciation+interest misunderstood by stakeholders; mitigated by clear reporting/communication
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting engine (W4427); GL (VS-17); AP/cash (VS-15/VS-18); BI (VS-28); audit (VS-21)
Time Estimate: - Engine-run hours monthly across portfolio; ~1–2 days close

steps.activity: Lease Accounting run the monthly engine — depreciation of ROU asset on straight-line over lease term; interest on lease liability (effective-interest method at discount rate W4412); reduction of liability for lease payment
Lease Accounting post journals (DR depreciation / CR ROU; DR interest / CR liability; DR liability / CR cash/AP) to GL (VS-17) and reconcile to lease-accounting system & AP/cash (VS-15/VS-18)
Controller/Audit review the monthly P&L split (depreciation + interest, replacing former straight-line rent expense — a key PFRS 16 EBITDA effect), and investigate variances

fields.Participants: Lease Admin (VS-42), Legal (VS-100), Treasury (VS-18), Real Estate (VS-97/VS-20), Audit (VS-21)

Automation Opportunity: - Lease-change intake & classification decision-tree; remeasurement engine; abstract/repository auto-update; disclosure flag
Controls: - CTL-675 (ensure controlled execution — ROU Asset & Lease Liability Measurement, Modification & Reporting (PA-148.2).)
- CTL-675: modifications identified & classified; liability remeasured at revised discount rate; ROU adjusted per PFRS 16; abstract/repository updated; reviewed (W4428)
Cross-references: - links to VS-42 (lease admin), VS-100 (legal), VS-18 (treasury), W4411 (abstract), W4412 (rate), W4425 (disclosure), W4426 (repository)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Missed-modification risk**: side-letter/amendment not captured → stale liability; mitigated by lease-admin change-feed & periodic sweep
- **Mis-classification risk**: separate-lease vs modification mis-called → wrong accounting; mitigated by classification guidance & review
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting engine (W4427); lease admin/contract (VS-42/VS-100); GL (VS-17); repository (W4426); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Lease Admin/Legal identify & classify the modification — *separate* lease (additional ROU for added scope/rights) vs *modification/remasurement* of the existing lease (payment/term/Scope change)
Lease Accounting remeasure the lease liability (revised payments at revised discount rate) and adjust the ROU asset correspondingly (or P&L for certain decreases), per PFRS 16
Lease Accounting post the remeasurement journal, update the abstract (W4411) & repository (W4426), and disclose material modifications (W4425)

fields.Frequency: Per event (~10–15 store openings + closures/yr + renewals)
fields.Owner: Lease Accounting / Lease Admin (VS-42) / Real Estate (VS-97)
fields.Participants: Lease Admin (VS-42), Real Estate (VS-97/VS-20), Store Ops (VS-07), Closure (VS-59), Legal (VS-100), Controller
fields.Trigger: Renewal exercised; termination; early exit; store closure (VS-59)

Automation Opportunity: - Renewal/termination event-trigger; remeasurement/derecognition engine; MAKE-GOOD provision calculator; closure coordination
Controls: - CTL-675: renewals reassessed; terminations derecognized with penalty/MAKE-GOOD provisioned; disposal coordinated (VS-35/VS-59); reviewed
Cross-references: - links to VS-42 (lease admin), VS-97/VS-20 (RE), VS-59 (closure), VS-35 (FA), W4412 (term), W4418 (remeasurement), W4423 (derecognition)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Termination-cost-miss risk**: penalty/MAKE-GOOD not accrued → earnings surprise; mitigated by full-clause capture (W4411) & provisioning
- **Renewal-judgment-staleness risk**: renewal certainty not refreshed → wrong term; mitigated by reassessment trigger
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting engine (W4427); lease admin (VS-42); closure (VS-59); FA (VS-35); GL (VS-17); repository (W4426)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting/Lease Admin account for **renewal** — reassess term/options (W4412), remeasure liability/ROU (W4418) if reasonably-certain determination changes
Lease Accounting/Real Estate account for **termination/early-exit** — derecognize ROU/liability (W4423), recognize termination penalty/early-exit payment, and handle MAKE-GOOD/restoration provision
Lease Accounting coordinate with store closure (VS-59), trigger fixed-asset/ROU disposal (VS-35/W4423), and update repository (W4426)

fields.Frequency: Per index revision / rent review (often annual)
fields.Participants: Lease Admin (VS-42), Treasury (VS-18), Finance (VS-17.4), Audit (VS-21), Real Estate (VS-97)
fields.Trigger: Index/CPI revision; turnover/usage variable; rent review
fields.Volume: Leases with index-linked/escalation clauses (~170–190 of the ~205 leases; the majority carry CPI or fixed-step escalators)

Automation Opportunity: - Index/CPI feed auto-trigger; variable-vs-index classification rule; remeasurement engine; variable-payment accrual
Controls: - CTL-675 (ensure controlled execution — ROU Asset & Lease Liability Measurement, Modification & Reporting (PA-148.2).)
- CTL-675: index-linked payments remeasured on revision; variable performance/usage expensed; distinction documented; reconciled to AP
Cross-references: - links to VS-42 (lease admin), VS-18 (treasury), VS-15 (AP), W4411 (abstract), W4418 (remeasurement), W4428 (controls)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Variable-vs-index-mis-classification risk**: turnover rent wrongly capitalized → mis-statement; mitigated by PFRS 16 distinction & documentation
- **Late-remeasurement risk**: index revision missed → stale liability; mitigated by index-feed trigger
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting engine (W4427); index/CPI data feed; lease admin (VS-42); AP (VS-15); GL (VS-17); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting/Lease Admin identify index-linked/escalation triggers (CPI, fixed escalation ladder) and variable payments based on index/rate — remeasure when the future payment adjusts
Lease Accounting distinguish variable-based-on-index/rate (remeasure liability) from variable-based-on-performance/usage (expense as incurred, e.g. turnover rent) per PFRS 16
Lease Accounting post remeasurement (W4418), accrue variable performance/usage payments to P&L, and reconcile to AP (VS-15)

fields.Participants: Real Estate (VS-97), Legal (VS-100), Finance (VS-17.4), Treasury (VS-18), Audit (VS-21), Tax (VS-79)
fields.Volume: Subleases (e.g. BuildRight subletting surplus space) + occasional SLB

Automation Opportunity: - Sublease/SLB classification engine; PFRS 15 sale-assessment tool; lessor-income calculation; disclosure auto-gen
Controls: - CTL-675 (ensure controlled execution — ROU Asset & Lease Liability Measurement, Modification & Reporting (PA-148.2).)
- CTL-675: sublease accounted as intermediate lessor; SLB sale-assessment per PFRS 15; lessor classification documented; disclosed & reviewed
Cross-references: - links to VS-97 (lessor/RE), VS-35 (FA), VS-100 (legal), VS-79 (tax), W4413 (classification), W4425 (disclosure), W4430 (settlement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sale-mis-classification risk** (SLB): wrong sale/not-sale call → mis-statement; mitigated by PFRS 15 assessment & review
- **Sublease-income-mis-recognition risk**: wrong lessor classification (finance vs operating); mitigated by IFRS 16 lessor model application
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting system (W4427); RE/lessor (VS-97); FA (VS-35); GL (VS-17); tax (VS-79); legal (VS-100); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting classify the sublease — BuildRight as **intermediate lessor**: retain lessee ROU/liability (scaled for right subleased) and recognize sublease income (finance or operating per IFRS 16 lessor model)

For SLB, Lease Accounting/Legal determine if the transfer qualifies as a **sale** under PFRS 15 — if sale: seller-lessee recognizes only proportionate ROU, buyer-lessor recognizes the asset; if not-sale: accounted as a financing
Lease Accounting post lessor-side/sublease journals, disclose (W4425), and coordinate with Property Mgmt (VS-97) for the lessor operating model

fields.Participants: Procurement (VS-34), ITAM (VS-99), Lease Admin (VS-42), Finance (VS-17.4), Audit (VS-21)
fields.Volume: Short-term & low-value leases (small equipment, IT, short tenancies) across portfolio

Automation Opportunity: - Exemption-rule engine; low-value threshold register; extension-monitor alert; expense-on-straight-line
Controls: - CTL-675 (ensure controlled execution — ROU Asset & Lease Liability Measurement, Modification & Reporting (PA-148.2).)
- CTL-675: exemptions applied per policy threshold; expensed straight-line; disclosed; monitored for extension; tested periodically (W4428)
Cross-references: - links to VS-34 (procurement), VS-99 (ITAM), VS-17 (GL), W4409 (policy), W4413 (classification), W4425 (disclosure)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Exemption-overuse risk**: leases wrongly exempted to avoid balance-sheet impact → audit finding; mitigated by threshold discipline & testing
- **Extension-blindness risk**: short-term lease extended >12 mo but still expensed → mis-statement; mitigated by extension monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting system (W4427); procurement (VS-34); ITAM (VS-99); GL (VS-17); audit (VS-21); repository (W4426)
Time Estimate: - ~15–30 min per exempt lease; periodic testing

steps.activity: Lease Accounting/Procurement identify leases qualifying for short-term (≤12 mo, no purchase option) or low-value (below threshold, e.g. <USD 5,000 standalone) exemption per policy (W4409)

Lease Accounting account for exempt leases on a **straight-line expense** basis (no ROU/liability), disclose the expense (W4425), and monitor for changes (extension beyond 12 mo) that remove the exemption
Lease Accounting/Audit periodically test the low-value threshold & short-term assessment, and reclassify if a lease no longer qualifies

fields.Participants: Controller, Fixed Assets (VS-35), Store Ops (VS-07), Closure (VS-59), Real Estate (VS-97), Audit (VS-21)
fields.Trigger: Closure (VS-59); abandonment; impairment indicator; lease end
fields.Volume: Derecognition/impairment events across portfolio (~10–15 closures/yr + lease ends)

Automation Opportunity: - Impairment-indicator alerts (closure trigger); derecognition engine; MAKE-GOOD settlement calculator; disposal coordination
Controls: - CTL-675 (ensure controlled execution — ROU Asset & Lease Liability Measurement, Modification & Reporting (PA-148.2).)
- CTL-675: ROU impairment tested at indicators; derecognized at end/termination; MAKE-GOOD settled; disposed via FA register; disclosed & reviewed
Cross-references: - links to VS-35 (FA), VS-59 (closure), VS-97 (RE), W4411 (abstract), W4419 (termination), W4425 (disclosure), W4426 (repository)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Impairment-miss risk**: ROU not impaired at closure → overstated assets; mitigated by impairment-indicator testing at closure
- **Derecognition-residual risk**: MAKE-GOOD/residual settlement mishandled; mitigated by full-clause capture (W4411)
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting system (W4427); FA (VS-35); closure (VS-59); GL (VS-17); repository (W4426); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting test ROU assets for impairment when indicators exist (closure, abandonment, under-performance), per IAS 36, and recognize impairment to P&L
Lease Accounting derecognize ROU/liability at lease end/termination (W4419), account for residual/MAKE-GOOD settlement, and dispose via fixed-asset register (VS-35)
Lease Accounting coordinate disposal with closure program (VS-59), update repository (W4426), and disclose material impairments (W4425)

fields.Participants: Consolidation (VS-17), Intercompany (VS-72), Lease Accounting, Treasury (VS-18), Audit (VS-21), Controller
fields.Volume: Intercompany leases across 5 entities (e.g. Property Mgmt → Depot)

Automation Opportunity: - Intercompany-lease auto-match; elimination rules engine; consolidated ROU/liability validation; exception workflow
Controls: - CTL-675 (ensure controlled execution — ROU Asset & Lease Liability Measurement, Modification & Reporting (PA-148.2).)
- CTL-675: intercompany leases identified & matched; eliminations posted; consolidated ROU/liability validated; reconciled to group FS; reviewed (W4428)
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (consolidation/GL), VS-72 (intercompany), VS-97 (lessor), W4416 (multi-entity setup), W4425 (close), W4430 (settlement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unmatched-intercompany risk**: lessor & lessee sides not matched → failed elimination → double-count; mitigated by intercompany-lease map & auto-match
- **Unrealized-profit-error risk**: profit on intercompany lease not eliminated; mitigated by elimination rules
System Touchpoints: - Consolidation system (VS-17); intercompany (VS-72); lease-accounting (W4427); lessor/RE (VS-97); GL (VS-17); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Consolidation/Intercompany identify intercompany leases (lessor & lessee within the 5-entity group — primarily Property Mgmt as lessor), and match lessee-ROU/liability to lessor-asset/income

Consolidation post elimination entries — eliminate intercompany lease income/expense, eliminate intercompany ROU/lease-liability vs lessor-asset, eliminate unrealized profit, and eliminate intercompany receivable/payable
Consolidation validate the consolidated ROU/liability, reconcile to group FS (VS-17), and resolve any unmatched intercompany lease
